snippet.title: Soulframe Founders | The Game Awards Teaser
snippet.description:
"Find me Faun, betray me again…"

Founders bundles for Soulframe: Preludes are available now. https://slfr.me/founders

Choose to join us and make your mark on Alca to get instant access to Preludes, as well as Wyld Pacts, Armour, and Weapons to aid you on your journey. 

Fey blood, steel, and soil entwine anew. Come, Envoy. Step deeper into the Wylds.

Join us, won't you?

Sign up and reserve your Envoy Title: https://www.soulframe.com
